REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part‑I, 22nd August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002‑Pub.
dated 2nd August; 2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may, be called the
Representation of the People (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Insertion of new section 20A, Act LXXXV of 1976

REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (THIRD
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part‑I, 22nd August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002‑Pub.
dated 2nd August; 2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
3. Insertion of new section
20A, Act LXXXV of 1976.‑‑‑In the said Act, after section
20, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:‑
"20A. Candidate to file
certificate of party affiliation. ‑‑‑Each contesting
candidate, before seeking allotment of prescribed symbol, shall file a
declaration before the Returning Officer about his party affiliation, if any,
alongwith a certificate from the political party showing that he is a party
candidate from the constituency."

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Third Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Insertion of new section 82A, Act LXXXV of 1976

REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part‑I, 22nd August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002‑Pub.
dated 2nd August; 2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
4. Insertion of new section
82A, Act LXXXV of 1976.‑‑In the said Act, after section 82, the
following new section shall be added, namely:‑
"82A. Capturing of
polling station and rolling booth, etc.‑‑ Whoever‑‑
(a)
seizes a polling station or a place fixed for the poll or makes polling authorities surrender the ballot papers or
ballot box or both and doing of any other act
which affects the orderly conduct of elections;
(b)
takes possession of a polling station or a place fixed for the poll and allow
his supporters to exercise
their right to vote and prevent other from free exercise of their right to vote;
(c)
coerces, intimidates or threatens directly or indirectly any elector and
prevents him from going to the
polling station or a place fixed for the poll to cast his vote; or
(d)
being in the service of Government or corporations or institutions controlled by the Government of all or any of the
aforesaid activities or aids or connives at, any
such activity in the furtherance of the prospects of the election of a
candidate,
shall be guilty of an offence
punishable with imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than three
years and may extend to five years and with fine which shall not be less than
fifty thousand rupees and may extend to one hundred thousand rupees or with
both."
